description: This file defines the GuzzleHttp Middleware class, containing static methods that generate middleware functions for HTTP request handling, including cookies management, error handling, request history tracking, request/response tapping, redirects, retries, logging, body preparation, and request/response mapping.

classes.name: Middleware
classes.description: Final class providing static factory methods to create various HTTP middleware functions for handling cookies, errors, request history, logging, redirects, retries, and request/response transformations in Guzzle HTTP client.

methods.name: cookies
methods.description: Creates middleware that adds cookies to outgoing requests, using a CookieJarInterface provided in options.

methods.name: httpErrors
methods.description: Creates middleware that throws exceptions for HTTP 4xx and 5xx responses when 'http_errors' option is enabled.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Creates middleware that records request and response data into a provided container (array or ArrayAccess) for history tracking.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Creates middleware that allows executing callback functions before and after the request is sent, without modifying the request or response.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Creates middleware that handles HTTP redirects.

methods.name: retry
methods.description: Creates middleware that retries requests based on a user-provided decider function, with optional delay strategy.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Creates middleware that logs requests, responses, and errors using a specified logger and formatter at a given log level.

methods.name: prepareBody
methods.description: Creates middleware that adds default headers related to request body content type and length.

methods.name: mapRequest
methods.description: Creates middleware that applies a transformation function to the request before sending.

methods.name: mapResponse
methods.description: Creates middleware that applies a transformation function to the response after receiving.
